field_principles.field_principles: Each field states why its evidence is needed.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Unavailable resources must stop calls before evidence can be invented.
field_principles.run_date: A real date places this result after the reporting cutover.
field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Pinned model declarations prevent silent substitution.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The method description separates request liveness from game evaluation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The closed class selects the correct duration floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: The venue identifies where process and GPU evidence was observed.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time makes local model execution plausible and auditable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source hashes bind the measurement to its implementation and inputs.
field_principles.rows: Canonical rows let an independent reader recompute all claims.
field_principles.per_model_request_rows: One row per required model prevents aggregate completion from hiding a missing call.
field_principles.model_repo_ids: Repository identities distinguish required models from substitutes.
field_principles.resolved_model_paths: Exact local paths bind requests to cached files.
field_principles.resolved_model_hashes: File hashes bind model names to exact bytes.
field_principles.quantization_rows: Quantization affects memory use and must be known for reproduction.
field_principles.model_load_rows: Load and cleanup receipts distinguish a resident process from a generation.
field_principles.prompt_hashes: Prompt hashes prove both bounded requests used the intended input.
field_principles.generated_token_rows: Nonzero decoded tokens are the direct liveness gate.
field_principles.finish_reason_rows: Finish reasons distinguish normal completion, limits, and timeouts.
field_principles.raw_output_hashes: Output hashes bind parser claims to external raw text.
field_principles.action_parse_rows: Parse rows show whether output became an action without a fallback.
field_principles.action_schema_validity_rows: Schema checks prevent prose or malformed actions from passing.
field_principles.request_timing_rows: Per-request timings expose missing or implausible execution.
field_principles.process_rows: PID evidence ties requests to real local server processes.
field_principles.gpu_telemetry_rows: Before and after samples prove the server occupied the leased GPU during each request.
field_principles.legacy_smoke_rows: An explicit empty list proves no legacy model satisfied a required cell.
field_principles.headline_model_rows: Role rows identify the mandated headline and ARC generator cells.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Development-proxy provenance prevents liveness from becoming hidden-game credit.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: False states that no action or solve replay occurred.
field_principles.arc_registry_hash_before: The starting hash anchors the no-registry-mutation check.
field_principles.arc_registry_hash_after: The ending hash exposes any registry mutation.
field_principles.arc_registry_delta: Zero prevents request liveness from adding solve credit.
field_principles.arc_generation_liveness_ready_score: Readiness needs both real requests, tokens, valid actions, telemetry, and cleanup.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed sampler seed makes the two requests reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A canonical digest detects later artifact-field drift.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failed check preserves expected and observed values.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False prevents a structural validator from becoming a game oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict supports deterministic downstream routing.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal statement reports liveness without claiming a solve.

inference_substrate: two bounded local E3 generation requests
